## **Bugs und Stabilität** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs und Stabilität.**
      2 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen bugs und stabilität.
      Review-Fenster: 06.06.2026 - 10.08.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer erwähnen Crashes oder Instabilität. Nur bei Volume-Spike oder nach einem Update als actionable werten; sonst oft Baseline-Rauschen.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _Anonymous User_, 16.07.2026, 1/5: "I'm a paid user. I love the app but there are times when it freezes. The freeze happens whenever interacting with habits. I'm experiencing this issue since a very long time. And now I got so frustrated that I'm looking for new habit tracker and cancel the subscription."
            2. _Mardon_, 06.06.2026, 1/5: "I have been using this app for more than a year already. I have recommended the app to many of my friends. But lately it has become so laggy to the degree I don't wanna use it anymore. I don't need fancy any animations. Devs, fix it already please. I'm on Pixel 7 Pro."
            3. _Andraev Reese Artamonov Fernandez_, 21.07.2026, 3/5: "I love the app, but lately I have been having issues to mark the habits that need multiple points, it does not register and I have to do it multiple times, is really annoying"
